items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (retrievePersistedQuery, restorePersistedQuery, unwrapRestoreResult, dataSource/errorSource). The public helper has a docstring, comments explain the non-obvious branches, and Prettier was applied.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Restore logic sits in query.ts, not a persister.ts module. It uses this.setState({...restoreResult.state}) instead of a dedicated reducer action. Bulk restore reimplements state application with existing.setState instead of sharing one path. PersisterRestoreResult<T, any> puts `any` on a public type.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Persisted state is not normalised: no count, timestamp or status checks, and status 'error' with a null error is not handled. The merge forces `isInvalidated: hasNewerError ? true : ...`. A hidden test fails: merged live data with a newer persisted error after bulk restore.

items.name: Restore path API contract
items.name_zh: 恢复路径 API 约定
items.evidence: createPersisterRestoreResult is exported and uses a Symbol brand, and success callbacks are skipped. There is no dedicated restore action (setState is used), and bulk restorePersistedQuery has its own separate merge/build logic instead of a shared restore application path.

items.name: Existing persister contract preserved
items.name_zh: 保持既有 persister 约定
items.evidence: unwrapRestoreResult passes non-marker values through unchanged. The QueryPersister return type is only widened, new exports are additive, createPersister options are unchanged, and the timestamp sync callback is kept for compatibility.
